title: -(으)ㄴ/는 바람에 causa adversa
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL guide describes **-는 바람에** as a causal expression that typically contributes to a negative result. It also specifies that the form does not combine with past -었- in the cause clause, requires 에, disallows commands/proposals in the following clause, and allows past reference through the documented form. This entry is limited to those constraints.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). *한국어교육 문법·표현 내용 개발 연구(3단계) [Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3)]*. https://www.korean.go.kr/common/download.do;front=B5CD4F10151810563982D51A3FD4329B?c_file_name=5a2db2bc-a7ad-49f4-84a4-34b20ad33ffc_0.pdf&file_path=reportData&o_file_name=%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%96%B4%EA%B5%90%EC%9C%A1+%EB%AC%B8%EB%B2%95%ED%91%9C%ED%98%84+%EB%82%B4%EC%9A%A9%EA%B0%9C%EB%B0%9C+%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC_3%EB%8B%A8%EA%B3%84.pdf

Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3), PDF pp. 462–463 (printed pp. 450–451): form restrictions, examples, polarity tendency, and comparison with -기 때문에.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **때문에**, que expresa causa de manera más general, y con **-(으)ㄴ/는 탓에**, que puede atribuir una causa negativa con un matiz de responsabilidad. También contrasta con **덕분에**, empleado típicamente cuando la causa se evalúa de forma favorable.
